title: Phase B3 slice 2 (D-076): proposal editor UI increment 1 - numeric 2263 draft authority (vertex table + levels/walls), run-check against the T057 route with typed-refusal decode, grouped shortfall report, client-local proposed variations; map composed read-only for context; NO drawing/transform/emission this increment (CRS bridge + scenario emission routed to the post-B3 owner checkpoint)
objective: Give the architect the first working proposal-editing experience over the accepted B3 route: a keyboard-first draft editor whose AUTHORITY is a numeric 2263 vertex/levels/walls model (display CRS stays display-only - the recorded measurement law; no client-side transform exists and none is added), the existing lot-outline map COMPOSED read-only beside it for context, a run-check action that POSTs the draft to /api/v1/proposal-checks and renders the grouped PASS/FAIL/COULD_NOT_CHECK report with numeric shortfalls exactly per the plan's phrasing ('18 ft provided; 20 ft required; 2 ft short'), and a client-local variations list - each variation labeled PROPOSED, never a city record, explicitly ephemeral (this browser session only; the platform is stateless and scenario-document emission is a deliberately deferred packet). Map-based outline drawing and the 4326-to-2263 bridge (a new-dependency/measurement design fork) plus scenario emission are OUT of this increment and are the named design questions for the D-076-R003 post-B3 owner checkpoint report.
business_reason: The owner demo after B3 needs a real editing-and-checking experience that is honest about what the numbers are; this increment delivers the check loop end-to-end with the strongest a11y shape (numeric table as the primary input) without smuggling in measurement dishonesty or an unadmitted dependency
inputs: CHECKPOINT ENVELOPE (binding): in every checkpoint, OMIT the four envelope fields (branch, worktree, starting_sha, current_sha) entirely - the controller fills the authoritative values. If you supply one it must be EXACT full-length (40-hex SHA, FULL worktree path).
REPORT DISCIPLINE (binding): reference files and line anchors, never embed long verbatim sections; every checkpoint carries IMPLEMENTATION; one concise evidence pass.

THIN CLIENT (binding): NEVER run or document npm/npx/node locally - web behavior (vitest, typecheck, lint, e2e) proves ONLY in CI on the pushed head; never mark web behavior verified from local reasoning. The only local commands are `python tools/modularity_check.py --check` from repo root. DOM queries typed per CODING_RULES (querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>); deliberate invalid-shape probes as `as unknown as T`; no empty .test/.spec files (seeded placeholders are trivially passing - replace, never empty).

NEW apps/web/src/lib/proposal-checks-api.ts - the typed POST client copying scenario-api.ts discipline EXACTLY (matrix mirror incl. the NEW `field` key decode on 422; Content-Length bound; bounded strings; timeout; announcements; recoverable gating; fetchImpl injection for tests).
